name: send-time-check
title: Send Time Check
description: Send-time check that shows the recipient's local time on a strip of their day, flags night, after-hours, weekend (including Friday–Saturday weekends) and holidays you pass, and offers a one-tap schedule for the start of their next working day.

meta.stops: Message landed at 2 AM their time
meta.summary: Shows the recipient's local time next to Send and offers to schedule for their next working morning when it's night, weekend or a holiday there.
catches: Night hours in the recipient's zone (default 22:00–07:00)
Their weekend, by zone (Friday–Saturday in Riyadh, Saturday in Kathmandu, otherwise Saturday–Sunday)
Next working-day start, DST-safe, as a one-tap schedule
limits: Weekend table is built in and coarse (by IANA zone, not by person or employer)
Holidays are not built in; pass them
Needs the recipient's real time zone; guessing it from a country can be wrong
a11y: Status message in a polite live region; the day strip is aria-hidden
Schedule is a labelled button; icons are aria-hidden

rules.note: Weekend-by-zone table (Fri–Sat in much of the Gulf, Sat-only in Nepal, Fri–Sun in Brunei) not re-verified against official sources this round. Check local rules before relying on it.
